## Limitations

Fixed hillshade is not mission-time illumination. Geometric visibility uses target centers and omits angular radius, terrain, horizon dip and operational requirements. Sampling controls event precision. Horizons uses the last known leap-second correction for future UTC; its returned ephemeris and frame metadata are preserved.
